parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 5 - Fairy Tale Update Part 1

Overview

Chance (Lethal) is a Secret Limited unit unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Chance and his evolved form is only available from the Ant Kingdom event. The Lethal Blessing gives Kite a 25% damage buff.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
